He is a {{convert|6|ft|11|in|cm|adj=on}} [[center (basketball)|center]]. He now runs the basketball program Team Sims Basketball located in [[Sandwich, Massachusetts|Sandwich]], [[Massachusetts]].{{Cite web |title=About Us |url=https://www.teamsimsbasketball.com/about-us/ |access-date=2024-04-08 |website=Sims Basketball Academy |language=en-US}} ==Early career== Sims played his college ball at the [[University of Michigan]], graduating in 2007, and previously attended the [[Noble & Greenough School]] for his high school education. With the [[Michigan Wolverines|Wolverines]], he averaged 9.5 points and 5.5 [[rebound (basketball)|rebounds]] in his four-year career. ==Professional career== Sims played briefly for the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]]'s [[Indiana Pacers]] in [[2007–08 NBA season|2007–08]]. Signed to a non-guaranteed contract after going undrafted, he appeared in only two games for the Pacers before being waived on December 4, 2007.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/transactions/dec2007_transactions.html |title=December 2007 Transactions |work=Nba.com |date=October 21, 2011 |access-date=November 14, 2011}} He was signed again on December 12,{{cite web |url=http://realgm.com/src_wiretap_archives/49684/20071212/pacers_sign_courtney_sims/ |title=Pacers Sign Courtney Sims |publisher=Realgm.com |access-date=November 14, 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081005175309/http://www.realgm.com/src_wiretap_archives/49684/20071212/pacers_sign_courtney_sims/ |archive-date=October 5, 2008 }} and waived again on December 19. Going scoreless in three total games, he had one rebound, one [[assist (basketball)|assist]] and committed two personal fouls in eleven minutes of action.{{cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/playerfile/courtney_sims/career_stats.html |title=Career Stats Page |work=Nba.com |date=October 21, 2011 |access-date=November 14, 2011 [[Phoenix Suns]] officially announced they signed Sims to a 10-day contract.{{cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/iowa/sims_090120.html |title=Iowa's Courtney Sims called up to Phoenix Suns his signing until the end of the season. Sims signed another ten-day contract on March 23, 2009, this time with the [[New York Knicks]],{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/knicks/news/sims_10day032309.html |title=Knicks Sign Courtney Sims to 10-Day Contract |work=Nba.com |date= |access-date=November 14, 2011}} and signed a second on April 2. On December 27 he was signed by [[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]] until the end of season with a club option to terminate the contract after one-month trial October 11. Sims signed with the [[Iowa Energy]] prior to the beginning of the 2010-11 NBA Development League Season. In the 2011 D-League All-star game, he scored 25 points and had 6 rebounds to earn the game MVP honors.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/blog/boston/celtics/post/_/id/4680928/all-star-2011-sims-shines-with-d-league-stars|title=Sims shines with D-League stars|access-date=February 20, 2011|date=February 20, 2011|publisher=[[ESPN]]|author=Forsberg, Chris}} In March 2011 he signed with the [[Dongguan Leopards]] in [[China]].[http://cbachina.163.com/11/0318/10/6VE0PNU700052UUC.html 弗罗曼替代者到位NBDL联赛MVP抵达东莞接受体检] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110721222857/http://cbachina.163.com/11/0318/10/6VE0PNU700052UUC.html |date=July 21, 2011 }} {{in lang|zh}} In September 2011 he signed a one-year deal with [[BK VEF Rīga]].{{cite web|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/87483/180/item |title=VEF Riga adds size with Sims |publisher=Euroleague.net |date= |access-date=November 14, 2011}} In July 2012 he signed a one-year deal with [[Jeonju KCC Egis]].[http://www.asia-basket.com/player.asp?Cntry=KOR&PlayerID=59494 Courtney Sims].
